messages:
sam: Heads-up — CI eval run failed/flaky for the quantized bring-up. p99 token latency jumped from ~120ms to ~650ms around 11:12 PDT. Screenshot: https://internal.charts/redwood/ops/abc123 (logs below).

priya: Which model and which commit? Is this the int8 candidate?

sam: model=redwood/open-7b-int8@c3f2a0e, eval harness commit=5a7e9f. small log snippet:
```
[11:11:58] eval-runner: dispatch batch id=342 size=16 occupancy=0.94
[11:12:01] worker-17: lease-lost shard=56 reason=oom
[11:12:02] eval-runner: retrying batch id=342 -> requeue
[11:12:05] eval-runner: dispatch batch id=342 size=2 occupancy=0.12
[11:12:07] token-gen: p99=652ms
```

julia: That's a classic batch-occupancy oscillation. When a shard dies/restarts the dispatcher immediately fragments work into tiny batches, which pushes occupancy down and increases per-token cost + p99. The int8 path has tighter memory margins so failures cascade.

ben: Do we see a retry storm? If many workers hit lease loss at once the dispatcher keeps re-slicing and re-sending tiny batches. Check retry/backoff config — if jitter is low we get synchronized retries.

sam: I grep'd the logs — many `lease-lost` events for adjacent shard IDs within a 10s window. retry policy currently: `retries=5, backoff=500ms, jitter=0.0` (that's probably the culprit).

deploy-bot: [ALERT] eval-runner.retry_rate high on cluster eval-us-west-2 (5m avg = 18/s) — triggered 11:12:10

priya: Proposed immediate mitigations: 1) set backoff jitter to ~200-500ms, 2) increase min_batch_size floor from 2 -> 8 for the quantized candidate, 3) suspend aggressive shard reshuffle for 10m to let workers stabilize. Any objections?

julia: +1. Also add a short-term canary: route 5% traffic to a non-quant variant to keep end-user SLOs. For long-term we should track the root cause (oom vs GC vs kernel crash).

ben: I'll open a PR to change retry policy defaults in the harness config and add `batch_occupancy_variance` and `retry_rate_by_shard` metrics to the eval-dashboard. Alert proposal: p99_token_latency > 500ms for 5m -> page eng-ml oncall.

sam: Repro steps I used locally: `./scripts/run-eval.sh --model redwood/open-7b-int8@c3f2a0e --concurrency 12 --num-shards 64 --seed 42` then `watch curl http://localhost:9090/metrics | grep batch_occupancy`. Seems to reproduce under VM mem throttle.

priya: Action items:
- ben: PR for backoff/jitter + dashboard panels (ETA 2h)
- julia: open infra bug to capture worker kube events (assign infra team) (ETA 4h)
- sam: run a canary with min_batch_size=8 and report p50/p95/p99 delta (ETA 1h)

ben: I'll also add a temporary alert on `batch_occupancy_variance` > 0.3 since that's highly predictive of oscillation.

sam: Thanks — will post results here. If we see persistent OOMs we may need to revert the quantized image or tune fusion kernels.

priya: Filing a ticket now: https://redwood.atlassian.com/browse/ML-2148 — linking this thread.

sam: FYI updated: canary run looks better with min_batch_size=8, p99 down to ~180ms. Still seeing a few lease-loss events though. Next steps: julia/infra dig into why adjacent shards failing.

julia: noted. I'll correlate kube events + node metrics and follow up in the ticket.

ben: PR up for backoff/jitter and dashboard panels: https://git.redwood/eng/eval-harness/pull/329 (WIP).
